newsitem.title: UK: ING Barings wins mandate for Tatarstan Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings wins mandate for Tatarstan Eurobond.

text.p: ING Barings said on Monday it had won the mandate to lead manage a dollar Eurobond for the Russian republic of Tatarstan.
Bankers said the bond was expected to be for a minimum of $200 million with a three to five-year maturity and a fixed-rate coupon.
The bond is expected to be launched in September or October following roadshows, they added.
In May president of Tatarstan Mintimer Shaimiyev said he expected Tatarstan to receive a credit rating no lower than the ratings on Russia's sovereign Eurobonds.
Russia's sovereign Eurobonds are rated Ba2 by Moody's, BB- by Standard & Poor's and BB+ by IBCA.
